experience.role_zh: 音频组负责人、音频总工
experience.role_en: Head of Audio Group & Chief Audio Engineer
experience.desc_zh: 负责 DJI 各产品线（手持影像：DJI Mic, OSMO Action, OSMO Pocket, OSMO Mobile等；无人机相关：无人机、遥控器、喊话器、眼镜等）音频系统软硬件交付、规划及音频团队（软件，硬件，算法，QA）管理。期间完成对本代各产品线的顺利交付，发布后取得较好经营结果；完成对未来产品音频软硬件技术规划体系的建立
experience.desc_en: Own audio system SW/HW delivery, planning and the audio team (SW/HW/algorithm/QA) across DJI product lines (handheld imaging: DJI Mic, OSMO Action, OSMO Pocket, OSMO Mobile, etc.; UAV-related: drones, remote controllers, megaphones, goggles). Delivered all current product lines with strong business results; established the audio technology planning system for future products.*

experience.role_zh: 音频组算法小组负责人
experience.role_en: Head of the Audio Algorithm Group
experience.desc_zh: 负责 DJI 各产品线音频算法技术方案的交付、预研及团队管理。完成算法自研体系的研发及落地，效果上达到或超过外部供应商及竞品水平。已完成工程化落地，现全面替代外部供应商方案实现全部算法自研。完成算法规划，预期下代产品的部分核心特性可以与竞品形成技术代差。
experience.desc_en: Own audio algorithm delivery, pre-research and team management across DJI product lines. Built the in-house algorithm R&D system; quality matches or beats external vendors and competitors. Now fully replacing vendor solutions with self-developed algorithms; the roadmap is expected to create a technology gap vs. competitors in next-gen products.*

experience.role_zh: DJI Mic 产品线软件总工
experience.role_en: Chief Software Engineer, DJI Mic Product Line
experience.desc_zh: 负责 DJI Mic 产品软件方案，包括 SoC 选型，音频、平台、无线模块系统公版方案设计。
experience.desc_en: Own the DJI Mic product software architecture, including SoC selection and the reference design of audio, platform and wireless modules.*

experience.desc_zh: 在快手音视频团队，负责音频算法研发。从零开始建设音频算法小组，已落地了快手主站、快影等多个应用的音频特性，如语音降噪、回声消除、音频分离、音频内容理解、风格转换、变声、音频多码率编码器、K歌音效、音频后处理、人声美化及无参考语音、音频评测等方向。发表顶会论文十余篇，专利数十篇。获得数项国际顶会音频挑战赛冠军。
experience.desc_en: Built the audio algorithm group from scratch and shipped features for Kuaishou's main app, Kuaiying and more: speech denoising, AEC, source separation, audio content understanding, style transfer, voice conversion, multi-bitrate audio codecs, karaoke effects, audio post-processing, voice beautification, and no-reference speech/audio quality assessment. Published 10+ top-conference papers and dozens of patents; won several international audio challenge championships.*

experience.org_zh: 西藏至慧桥资产管理有限公司
experience.desc_zh: 作为合伙人加入至汇桥资管，主要负责基于数量化的交易算法研发。自研并实盘了市场中性的股票选股策略、指数择时策略、股指期货择时策略、FOF 投资组合策略等。管理资金规模人民币 5000 万元。资管产品获得2018年中信期货全国私募实盘大赛股票策略组第一名；2020年 wind 三年期全国最强私募基金 FOF。
experience.desc_en: Led quantitative trading algorithm R&D: market-neutral stock selection, index timing, stock-index futures timing, and FOF portfolio strategies, traded live with RMB 50M AUM. The fund won 1st place in CITIC Futures' 2018 national live-trading competition (equity strategy) and Wind's 2020 3-year Best Private FOF.*

experience.org_zh: 音曼（北京）科技有限公司
experience.desc_zh: 作为联合创始人加入音曼科技（获天津九安医疗旗下尚势资本千万级天使投资）。主要负责算法研究，知识产权，同时和CEO一起把控产品量产交付。发布音曼OMNOS回音壁音箱产品（德国红点设计奖）、移动 KTV 核心 DSP 算法板、Ambisonic 声场麦克风等音频硬件产品，累计实现近千万销售额。
experience.desc_en: Co-founded Yinkman Technology (angel-funded by Shishang Capital). Led algorithm research and IP, and co-managed product mass production. Shipped the OMNOS soundbar (Red Dot Design Award), a mobile-KTV DSP board and an Ambisonic sound-field microphone, achieving near-RMB-10M cumulative sales.*

experience.desc_zh: 博士毕业后加入杜比实验室，作为杜比实验室全球最年轻的高级研究员，参与了杜比全景声在移动端落地的多个重点项目的算法研究工作，如 DOLBY ATMOS for Headphone、DOLBY ATMOS for Mobile（全球第一个搭载杜比全景声的平板电脑：Lenovo Yoga 3）等。
experience.desc_en: The youngest Senior Researcher in Dolby at the time. Algorithm research for key Dolby Atmos mobile programs, e.g. Dolby Atmos for Headphones and Dolby Atmos for Mobile (world's first tablet with Dolby Atmos: Lenovo Yoga 3).
